audit_question: Was inflammation measured before resistance and were causal alternatives controlled?
decision: Causal wording blocked because most TRD evidence is cross-sectional or measured after prior treatment exposure

claim_or_issue: Inflammatory biomarker defines distinct TRD disease
audit_question: Has a pretreatment biomarker been independently validated to predict future multi-trial TRD?
decision: No such validated classifier identified in pilot; ontology claim blocked

claim_or_issue: GENDEP publications treated as separate replications
audit_question: Do Uher and Cattaneo publications arise from independent cohorts?
decision: No. They are companion analyses within GENDEP and were collapsed into SF001

claim_or_issue: CO-MED immune publications treated as separate replications
audit_question: Do Jha Gadad and later immunomarker analyses arise from independent cohorts?
decision: No. They are secondary analyses of NCT00590863 and were collapsed into SF002

claim_or_issue: EMBARC immune publications treated as separate replications
audit_question: Are later EMBARC immune analyses independent datasets?
decision: No. They belong to NCT01407094 and were collapsed into SF003

claim_or_issue: Infliximab companion biomarker papers treated independently
audit_question: Do metabolic/gene-expression infliximab papers represent new randomized samples?
decision: No. They reuse the 60-person infliximab parent trial and were collapsed into SF004

claim_or_issue: Hummad 2026 pooled OR used as confirmatory evidence
audit_question: Does the meta-analysis pool independent study families addressing the same causal question?
decision: Not reliably. Multiple parent-cohort publications and heterogeneous study questions are present; confirmatory use blocked pending reconstruction

claim_or_issue: High CRP infliximab subgroup interpreted as proof of inflammatory TRD subtype
audit_question: Was the subgroup threshold and treatment interaction confirmatory and independently replicated?
decision: Interaction is promising but subgroup response comparison was exploratory/imprecise; endotype claim limited to hypothesis-generating

claim_or_issue: Regulatory/later-line TRD treatment pathway implies separate disease
audit_question: Does treatment indication establish separate diagnostic ontology?
decision: No. Treatment population and ontology are separated by protocol

audit_question: Does the search interface expose reproducible source/date/query result totals?
decision: No. Counts were omitted rather than estimated

claim_or_issue: H1 distinct disease versus H3 endotype
audit_question: Does inflammation specifically identify future TRD rather than an MDD subgroup that modifies treatment response?
decision: Current evidence favors cross-cutting candidate endotype over TRD-specific disease boundary

audit_question: Can stage severity treatment exposure comorbidity and biological endotype jointly explain the observed evidence?
decision: Yes. Mixed model best accommodates both positive treatment interactions and inconsistent/general confounded prediction
